title: Gigabytes-per-second SIMD Vectorized JSON Parsing
pre_discovery_prompt: JSON parsing in high-performance native engines is bottlenecked by character-by-character branch mispredictions and sequential state machines. How can CPU vector instructions achieve multi-gigabyte/sec throughput?
ground_truth_finding: Two-stage SIMD pipeline: Stage 1 locates structural characters concurrently using bitmasks/SIMD, Stage 2 constructs the DOM tree with minimal branching.
notes_on_reconstruction: Stripped simdjson project name and author names.
